beats.say: A razor sells itself. The handle never leaves the store.
A handle with a few blades, still cheap.
A premium razor with a built-in blade dispenser, pricey.
A handle with endless blade refills, the one you actually buy.
But it does a job - the razor-and-blade trap.
Every handle forces you into the blade plan.
In year two they sold 90,884 handles and 123,648 blades.
One purchase locks you into buying blades forever.
Coffee shop: $15 mug, $30 mug with lid, $45 mug-plus-lid subscription.
Barber: $5 trim, $12 trim with a razor, $20 razor-plus-trim package.
Watch for a cheap entry that hides a recurring cost. Follow for more.
